import TransposeFollowup.CompactInputMeasure
import TransposeFollowup.NativeIOZipper
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def measureMarkedExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def measureBits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map (fun j => n.testBit j)
def measureHeads : Fin 3 → Int := ![-7,29,-51]
def compactMeasureCheck (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let c : NativeIOZipper.Config (Fin 3) CompactInputMeasure.Label :=
    ⟨⟨⟨CompactInputMeasure.start,InputMeasure.initial⟩,measureHeads⟩,0,[true,false]⟩
  let r:=NativeIOZipper.run CompactInputMeasure.program xs (41*xs.length+65) c
  decide (r.work.core.pc=.done) && (List.finRange 3).all (fun p => decide (r.work.pos p=measureHeads p)) &&
    measureMarkedExact (r.work.core.tapes 0) xs &&
    (r.work.core.tapes 1).left.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (r.work.core.tapes 1).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    measureMarkedExact (r.work.core.tapes 2) (measureBits xs.length.size xs.length) &&
    decide (r.inputPos=xs.length) && decide (r.outRev=[true,false])

def measureWords : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (measureWords n).flatMap (fun xs => [false::xs,true::xs])
def compactPatterns (m : Nat) : List (List Bool) :=
  [List.replicate m false,List.replicate m true,(List.range m).map (fun j => decide (j%3=0))]
def compactMeasureTests : List Bool :=
  ((List.range 7).flatMap measureWords).map compactMeasureCheck ++
  ([7,8,9,15,16,17,31,32,33,63,64,65,127,128,129,255,256,257,512].flatMap compactPatterns).map compactMeasureCheck
#eval (compactMeasureTests.count true,compactMeasureTests.count false)
